def max_rect_in(g, mask):
    # largest solid same-color rectangle within mask
    best=None
    R,C=g.shape
    ys,xs=np.where(mask)
    v=g[ys[0],xs[0]]
    # restrict to bbox for speed
    r1,r2,c1,c2=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
    sub=(g[r1:r2+1,c1:c2+1]==v)&mask[r1:r2+1,c1:c2+1]
    H,W=sub.shape
    # maximal rectangle in binary matrix
    heights=np.zeros(W,int)
    best=(0,None)
    for r in range(H):
        heights=[heights[c]+1 if sub[r,c] else 0 for c in range(W)]
        stack=[]
        for c in range(W+1):
            h=heights[c] if c<W else 0
            start=c
            while stack and stack[-1][1]>=h:
                s,hh=stack.pop()
                area=hh*(c-s)
                if area>best[0]: best=(area,(r1+r-hh+1, r1+r, r1+s, r1+c-1))
                start=s
            stack.append((start,h))
    return best
